issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Farm song API: the problem statement (UML and Part 3 instructions) asks students to implement a method named printFarmSong() in Farm.java, while both the provided template and the reference solution expose a public method named singFarmSong(). This discrepancy (problem_statement: printFarmSong vs. template/solution: singFarmSong) can confuse students about which method to implement or call and may cause examples/tests in the statement to not match the template/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API name consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement and UML to reference singFarmSong() everywhere (adjust examples and instructions), or (B) rename the template and solution method to public printFarmSong() (and update any call sites such as Main) so the code matches the documented API. If you prefer to keep both names for backwards compatibility, add a public printFarmSong() that delegates to the existing singFarmSong() implementation and update the statement to note the canonical name.
